_doc: Items that only exist in this campaign (merged over data/items.json).

cellar_key.name: Cellar Key
cellar_key.desc: Opens the cellar of the Gilded Heron.

barrow_key.name: Black Iron Key
barrow_key.desc: Heavy, cold, and older than the town. It fits the iron door in the Barrow.

tova_crate.name: Tova's Crate
tova_crate.desc: Bar iron and steel blanks, stamped with a hammer mark.

hollow_crown.name: The Hollow Crown
hollow_crown.desc: A circlet of black iron. It is much too light, as if something had been taken out of it.
